newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel to turn south if 128.56 goes.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel to turn south if 128.56 goes.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF face a retreat to the 128.24 area on Friday if support around 128.56 is broken decisively, technical analysts said.
"It's not looking too clever," said Marc Ostwald, techical strategist at London Bond Broking. "The big level on the downside is the 128.56 area."
The notionnel was quoted at 128.68 at 0741 GMT, down 22 basis point from the opening.
The contract gapped down to 128.74 at the open from Thursday's low of 128.84. It then slipped to a low of 128.52 but recovered some poise.
Ostwald said support around 128.56 comes from a small top of highs from April 8, 10 and 11.
"If we don't hold that I'd be looking for it to slip back to 128.24," he said, citing lows from the same period in early April. Below that, the low on April 14 would be the next target.
Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, also saw the contract heading lower if support nearby around 128.70 disappeared.
"Yesterday we were forming a fairly solid up channel at 128.70," he said. "A close below that would look negative short term."
He too, saw secondary support stepping in around the 128.50 area.
To the upside, resistance was strong at 129.00, Ostwald said. "If we can claw anything back I'd be looking for resistance at 129.00, the big figure," he said.
Beyond there congestion came in at 129.34,38, he said.
June Pibor were quoted at 96.53, down five basis points from Thursday.
